Y=0 meridional cut of the sealed scroll (not the axial-duct wake crop). |U| and pressure only — outlet is +X, inlet is +Z. Axial-Uz is omitted because this is a radial machine.
90° discharge collector — not an A12x25 drop-in. Assess uses sealed-enclosure radial MRF (+Z inlet / +X outlet). Optimize is a geometry proxy (ranking only — not CFM).
